commonAttrs.name: description
commonAttrs.description: Free-form user-facing prose. Markdown allowed, multi-line via YAML '|' block scalar. Flows into doc-gen surfaces (JSDoc / XML-doc / Postgres COMMENT / Mermaid prose).

commonAttrs.name: summary
commonAttrs.description: Short single-line tagline (OpenAPI `summary` pattern) — used in index tables, sidebar previews, and AI prompts where the full @description is too long. Optional supplement to @description; when @summary is unset, doc surfaces typically fall back to the first sentence of @description.

commonAttrs.name: title
commonAttrs.description: Short single-line human label (e.g. 'Email' for a `field.string email`). Optional supplement to description.

commonAttrs.name: notes
commonAttrs.description: Internal-only rationale. Stays in metadata; never emitted to user-facing docs.

commonAttrs.name: deprecated
commonAttrs.description: Text reason for deprecation. Presence ⇒ deprecated. Codegen emits @deprecated / [Obsolete] with this reason.

commonAttrs.name: replacedBy
commonAttrs.description: FQN reference to the replacement element. Only meaningful with `deprecated`. Codegen appends 'Replaced by <ref>' to deprecation messages.

commonAttrs.name: seeAlso
commonAttrs.description: External documentation URLs. Codegen emits @see / <seealso href=...>.

commonAttrs.name: aliases
commonAttrs.description: Alternate names for this element. Aids AI authoring disambiguation, search, migration.
